caption_en:
Every country has one city that runs it, and one that never sleeps. 🏙️

🇮🇱 Jerusalem and Tel Aviv: 55 km apart. Jerusalem is the seat of the Knesset and the government; Tel Aviv was founded in 1909, on the sand.
🇹🇷 Ankara and Istanbul: 349 km
🇲🇦 Rabat and Casablanca: 85 km
🇸🇦 Riyadh and Jeddah: 845 km
🇺🇸 Washington and New York: 328 km
🇦🇺 Canberra and Sydney: 247 km
🇨🇭 Bern and Zurich: 95 km
🇪🇬 Egypt went the other way: since April 2024 its seat of government is a brand new city, The New Capital, about 50 km east of Cairo.

Washington (chosen in 1790), Canberra (site chosen in 1908) and Ankara (capital since 1923) were picked to be capitals. Jerusalem was King David's capital about 3,000 years ago.

Distances are straight lines between city centres (our calculation). Which city would you pick?

Sources: US Senate (Residence Act 1790); Parliament of Australia (Seat of Government Act 1908); Grand National Assembly of Türkiye (13 Oct 1923); Tel Aviv-Yafo Municipality (founded 1909); ACUD and Egyptian Streets, Nov 2025 (The New Capital, seat of government since 2 April 2024).
Photos: Western Wall Plaza, Gary Todd (CC0); Tel Aviv, Markus Trienke (CC BY-SA 3.0); Istanbul, SegLig (CC BY 4.0); Hassan II Mosque, Casablanca, OussamaHamama (CC BY-SA 4.0); New York, Oleg Yunakov (CC BY-SA 4.0); Sydney, Dietmar Rabich (CC BY-SA 4.0); The New Capital, Mohamed Ouda (CC BY-SA 4.0); all via Wikimedia Commons.
caption_he:
לכל מדינה יש תל אביב. עיר אחת שמנהלת, ועיר אחת שלא נרדמת.
ירושלים ותל אביב: 55 ק"מ. אנקרה ואיסטנבול: 349. רבאט וקזבלנקה: 85. ריאד וג'דה: 845. וושינגטון וניו יורק: 328. קנברה וסידני: 247. ברן וציריך: 95.
מצרים הלכה הפוך: מאפריל 2024 הממשלה יושבת בעיר חדשה במדבר, כ-50 ק"מ מקהיר.
ירושלים מתפללת, חיפה עובדת, תל אביב חוגגת. ואיזו עיר אתם הייתם בוחרים?

lines.line: Every country has a Tel Aviv.
And a Jerusalem. One city runs the country. The other one has the fun.
Israel: Jerusalem, seat of the Knesset and the government. Tel Aviv: beaches and startups. Fifty-five kilometers apart.
Turkey: Ankara runs it. Istanbul gets the tourists.
Morocco: Rabat is the capital. Casablanca is the business hub.
Saudi Arabia: Riyadh rules. Jeddah is the city by the sea.
America: Washington and New York. Australia: Canberra and Sydney. Switzerland: Bern and Zurich.
Notice something? Washington, Canberra, Ankara: all picked to be capitals.
Jerusalem was a capital three thousand years ago. Tel Aviv was founded in 1909.
Egypt went the other way. In 2024 it moved its government out of Cairo, to a brand new city in the desert.
So how far apart are the two cities?
Israel: fifty-five kilometers. Only Egypt's brand new capital is closer.
Israelis say: Jerusalem prays, Haifa works, Tel Aviv plays.
If you love Israeli facts, follow Noam Roz for more.
So, where's your country's Tel Aviv?
